$comment: Known invalid responses per spec. See scripts/corpus.ts.

apple-app-store-connect.note: oneOf lists the same schema object several times (included[] on appCategories/appInfos), and errors[].source is a oneOf of two all-optional objects; no value matches exactly one branch

codat-accounting.note: allOf: [{type: string}, {type: null}] for nullable fields (e.g. currency) is unsatisfiable

github.note: oneOf error bodies (409/422 on contents and blobs) whose branches have no required fields; any realistic object matches both

linode.note: payment method oneOf has identical Credit Card / Google Pay branches; label pattern ^[a-zA-Z]((?!--|__|..)…)+$ uses `..` (any two chars), so it only admits 2-character labels while minLength is 3

nexmo-verify.note: oneOf error bodies whose branches are all-optional objects with the same fields

shipengine.note: wrappers set additionalProperties: false next to allOf, so they forbid every property (including required ones); carrier settings oneOf branches each accept only {}; created_at is both date-time and an se-id pattern

vercel.note: fields declared {type: "null", oneOf: [string, number]} (a broken 3.0 nullable conversion) are unsatisfiable

zuora.note: object definition allOf gives `origin` contradicting enums (system vs custom) across members
